rules.text: If the pie-slice inscriptions are valid market-share values bound to their enclosing labeled brands, and the chart title identifies the same Europe smartphone-market scope requested by the task, then the brand with the largest printed percentage is the current market leader; the matching workflow option should be selected.
rules.conditions: This bridge depends on treating the printed percentages and their brand attachments as authoritative and on interpreting “market leader” as the largest current market share in the titled Europe scope.

rules.text: If the graphic is intended as a proportionally encoded pie chart, each sector’s angular area should correspond to its printed percentage. A visible mismatch between sector sizes and the attached printed percentages leaves the market-leader conclusion underdetermined unless the task specifies that the inscriptions, rather than pie geometry, control.
rules.conditions: This bridge applies only if the sector geometry is intended to encode the same market-share quantity as the printed labels; no task instruction establishes precedence between conflicting chart elements.
